sequences.name: Swine Producer Outbound — Finisher & Farrow-to-Finish
sequences.description: 6-step outbound sequence targeting Production Managers and Herd Health Coordinators at swine finishing and farrow-to-finish operations. sequences.name: Poultry Producer Outbound — Broiler & Layer
sequences.description: 6-step outbound sequence targeting Farm Managers and Directors of Operations at broiler and layer operations. Leads with ammonia compliance and mortality alerting use cases. sequences.name: Enterprise Integrator Outreach
sequences.description: 7-step executive-level sequence targeting VPs and Directors at poultry and swine integrators. Focused on grower compliance monitoring, contract performance reporting, and liability reduction at scale. Includes a custom ROI model for integrator fleets. Step 6 offers a private executive briefing. Highest reply rate of all sequences.

sequences.name: Post-Demo Nurture — Mid-Market
sequences.description: 4-step post-demo follow-up sequence for mid-market prospects who completed a product demo but have not yet received a proposal. Sends ROI summary (step 1), customer video testimonial (step 2), competitive comparison one-pager (step 3), and a time-limited pilot offer (step 4). 28.6% reply rate is the highest of any sequence.

sequences.name: Content MQL Nurture
sequences.description: 5-step nurture sequence for contacts who downloaded gated content (whitepaper, ROI calculator, case studies). Educational tone — not salesy. Step 3 links to a 3-minute product demo video. Step 5 soft CTA to book a call. Lower reply rate expected; goal is to warm MQLs until sales-ready.
